name: Thabbashite Deacon
subtitle: the living gods call for collection
rules: When a card that provides at least [V] enters play under your control, you may pick a faction. If you do, it gains 1 influence.
flavor: The clergy of the Doarden tribes have developed an ingenious way of coercing the masses to give offerings. They fashion collection baskets from the skulls of recalcitrant Thabbashites and then voidally augment the skulls into monstrous shapes capable of biting.

name: Micromajig
subtitle: tell me i'm beautiful. lie to me if necessary
flavor: Micromajigs are a humanoid pattern majig, standing perhaps half a foot tall, powered by an identical voidal circuitry core.They are not particularly strong, such as the luteoderm goliath, nor are they astonishingly powerful, such as the runic cannon, but they are unusually prolific. In fact, it is often postulated without question that the micromajig represents the single most common piece of voidal engineering in Luridia today. It is this element of quantity that the architects and inventors find so threatening, offensive, inspiring or simply ludicrous, according to their own views.
notes: Token card, no cost corner. Italic text is flavor, no rules text. Print has 'core.They' with no space.

name: Microdefense Autosystem
subtitle: a fun way to play
rules: When you form a blocking party with at least 1 character, you may pay 1. If you do, put a Micromajig token into play under your control. Add it to the blocking party.
flavor: This is our fort. No 80y5 allowed.
notes: Footer also prints 'Original Open R&D Concept by kallisti'.

name: Micromajig
subtitle: fetch the diamond codpiece!
flavor: What motivates the Master to create these micromajigs is anyone's guess. Is he a folk hero, dedicated to breaking an irrational proscription against mass production? Is he simply a deviant, delighting in his multiplicative transgression against tradition? Perhaps one day the creator of the micromajig and their motives will become known to history. In the meantime, one would be wise to exercise caution when mentioning the subject in the company of tinkers, lest you find yourself subject to impassioned opinion.
notes: Token card, no cost corner. Italic text is flavor, no rules text.

name: Hasty Pursuit
subtitle: thabbashites do not play around when you steal their gods
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only on your turn. -- This turn, characters you control and deploy can attack even if they have not been in play under your control since the start of the turn. Draw a card. If you picked any characters as part of this card's FLIP UP cost, deplete those characters. -- FLIP UP – 4 [E][E][E] and you may pick up to 2 characters.
